label: 40 Heating - Control
info:
Control loop (every 60 s): schedule, weather curve + PI, stage clamp, relay and eBUS.
input_boolean.heating_live off = dry-run (calculate and log only).
Entity IDs: the 'Heating config' node. Docs: https://github.com/IJMOK/eBus-Heating

label: 41 Heating - Comfort
info: Comfort events from the control loop (notify, mark the day, demote one stage) and the Comfort-mode button.

label: 42 Heating - Nightly
info:
03:00 review: day stats, learning per stage, promotion check (asks for approval, never promotes by itself).
Also the one-off 'Set starting values' button.

label: 43 Heating - Heartbeat
info:
Heartbeat to the Shelly failsafe script (KVS 'hb' over MQTT RPC) while HA is in live control,
and the Shelly's failsafe mode mirrored into input_text.heating_failsafe_mode.

name: Read me
info:
All installation-specific IDs are in 'Heating config'.
Outputs of 'Control law': 1 HA calls, 2 eBUS SetMode (disabled in config until Stage 1), 3 comfort event.
